---
title: "Activity Reports"
---

ÇAHSPAR aims to make its activity reports a transparent account of progress towards its international research mission. Reports will distinguish completed activities from work in development and relate outputs to the association’s priorities in working life and social policy.

## Areas to Be Covered

- Comparative research, countries studied and the coverage and limitations of data
- International partnerships, joint project proposals and collaborative outputs
- Academic publications, policy briefs and engagement with international research
- Conferences, workshops, methodological exchange and researcher development
- Participation across regions, institutions and career stages
- The international visibility of research from Türkiye and reciprocal knowledge exchange
- Evidence of engagement with practitioners, policymakers and civil society

Reporting will consider the quality and continuity of collaboration alongside activity counts. Where regional comparisons are used, the geographical framework and country coverage will be stated explicitly.
